text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, that takes care of all the 
preparations for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there should be some 
free time in tomorrow's schedule. If I can 
make good use of it... ...Still, can I 
really rearrange it from here...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, there's a possibility of achieving 
even greater results. Let's do it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ikuno Dictus ended up staying up 
late into the night.
